name: Point-NeRF Representation
definition: A point-based radiance field representation that uses a neural point cloud to model a continuous volumetric radiance field, avoiding ray sampling in empty space by leveraging classical point clouds that approximate scene geometry.
summary: Point-NeRF represents volumetric radiance fields using explicit neural point clouds, avoiding empty space sampling and using inverse-distance weighted aggregation of local features rather than set-theoretic operations or analytic splatting.
